placements.why: Both segments ratify an architectural contract — the async job dispatch model for remember — placing them squarely in the Architecture strata, which does not yet exist in this repo.
placements.title: System design contracts and structural decisions
placements.theme: Architectural contracts define how system components interact and what operational properties they guarantee.

placements.title: Remember returns immediately, work completes asynchronously
placements.theme: The remember call dispatches work and returns a receipt in seconds, letting the agent poll a cursor or receive piggybacked reactions without blocking or losing work.
placements.why: src-1 ratifies the receipt-in-seconds, cursor-polling, no-blocking, no-lost-work guarantees; src-2 specifies the dispatch-then-poll-or-piggyback mechanism. Together they form a single directional theme about non-blocking async completion of the remember call.
